verdict.rationale: The MI325X is hardware, so it has no source in the usual sense, but its first-party software stack, ROCm (compilers, HIP runtime, math and communication libraries, profiling tools), is documented as open source and optimized for AMD Instinct devices. That makes much of the code you run on the product readable. However, the evidence names no specific license and gives no repository links, and the hardware design and firmware have no open-source evidence. Missing for 10: named open license terms, links to public source repositories, evidence on firmware or driver openness, independent corroboration.
